verdict.rationale: Riskified's Chargeback Gateway Integration (CGI) is documented as automating 'end-to-end chargeback handling from chargeback reporting to the disputing process' across major gateways, implying dispute evidence submission without manual copy-paste, and Riskified already ingests order, session (Beacon), and decision data through its APIs. However, the docs don't explicitly describe compiling delivery data or detail the specific evidence package sent to issuers during disputes. Missing for 10: explicit description of delivery-data inclusion in chargeback evidence, detail on the dispute evidence package format submitted to issuers, and independent/hands-on confirmation that submission is fully automated end-to-end.
